text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Now that's the power of a true queen!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Of course it is. I am the number one Umamusume, you know.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I was never going to lose. I did it... I'm
number
one...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Awww! I wanted to see her race against
Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Right?! I really wanted to see them
battle it out!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I should be happy about making it to
number
one, but I just feel unsatisfied!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet is crowned Queen of the
Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the race only affirms her sense
that
she's missing something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It might be time for her to finally
confront her
rival.
